translations.实时定制 Codex 视觉系统: Customize the Codex visual system in real time
translations.此区域使用主题基础表面: This region uses the base theme surface
translations.AI 重新生成完整图标集: Regenerate full icon set with AI
translations.关闭前要应用当前主题修改吗？: Apply the current theme changes before closing?
translations.开发构建只检查更新，不自动替换程序: Development builds can check for updates but cannot replace the application automatically.
translations.target 目录中的开发程序不能自动安装: Development executables in the target directory cannot install updates automatically.
translations.当前构建不支持自动安装: This build does not support automatic installation.
translations.直接在页面捕捉元素: Pick an element on the page
translations.未设置，使用 Codex 原生头像: Not set; using the native Codex avatar
translations.留空时沿用 Codex 账户名称: Leave empty to use the Codex account name
translations.高级皮肤可添加品牌、插画、组件表面和空白首页。关闭时不会改变 Codex 原有结: Advanced skins can add branding, artwork, component surfaces, and an empty-state home without changing the native Codex structure when disabled.
translations.沿用 Codex 原图标，不改颜色也不替换资源。: Keep the native Codex icons without recoloring or replacing assets.
translations.保留 Codex 原图标，只应用默认颜色与激活颜色。: Keep native Codex icons and apply only the default and active colors.
translations.优先使用下面的自定义映射，缺失项自动回退原图标。: Prefer the custom mappings below and fall back to native icons when an asset is missing.
translations.生成图标集需要已配置生图 Key；生成后先作为草稿预览，点击底部“应用”才会保存: Generating an icon set requires an image API key. Results remain a draft until you click Apply.
translations.装饰层不接收鼠标事件，不会遮挡 Codex 操作。: Decorations do not capture pointer events or block Codex controls.
translations.主题需求、参考图、资源计划、生成进度和日志已统一放入生成工作台。此处只管理连接设: Theme requests, references, asset plans, progress, and logs are available in the generation workspace. This section manages connection settings only.
translations.在工作台内填写需求、添加参考图、查看每项资源与实时日志。: Enter requirements, add references, and inspect each asset and live log in the workspace.
translations.点击主题卡片即可切换；右侧菜单可编辑名称和介绍、导出或删除主题。: Click a theme card to switch. Use its menu to edit details, export, or delete it.
translations.边框与输入区颜色过于接近，运行时会自动提高边框对比度。: The runtime automatically increases border contrast when it is too close to the composer color.
translations.标题中的品牌水印固定不变；这里只调整右下角入口。: The title-bar brand mark is fixed. These controls only adjust the bottom-right launcher.
translations.如何捕捉 CSS 位置: How to capture a CSS selector
translations.按 F12 或 Ctrl+Shift+I 打开开发者工具。: Press F12 or Ctrl+Shift+I to open Developer Tools.
translations.按 Ctrl+Shift+C 后点击要修改的位置。: Press Ctrl+Shift+C, then click the element you want to customize.
translations.在 Elements 面板右键节点，选择 Copy → Copy selecto: In the Elements panel, right-click the node, choose Copy > Copy selector, then paste it below.
translations.也可点击上方按钮，再点击 Codex 页面中的目标位置，选择器会自动写入 CSS: You can also use the picker above and click a target in Codex to insert its selector automatically.
translations.自定义 CSS 可以隐藏或伪造页面内容。只有你完全信任的本地主题才应启用。: Custom CSS can hide or imitate page content. Enable it only for local themes you fully trust.
translations.需求、参考图、资源、日志与静态预览都在这里完成: Requirements, references, assets, logs, and the static preview are all managed here
translations.可选：添加参考图分析配色、氛围和层级。也可以 Ctrl+V 直接粘贴图片。: Optionally add reference images to analyze color, mood, and hierarchy. You can also paste images with Ctrl+V.
translations.生成背景、Hero、装饰和卡片图标: Generate backgrounds, hero art, decorations, and card icons
translations.生成左侧导航水印（默认关闭，避免遮挡导航）: Generate a left-sidebar watermark (off by default to keep navigation clear)
translations.生成完整主题图标（6×5 图集自动切割为 30 项）: Generate a complete theme icon set (a 6x5 atlas split into 30 assets)
translations.使用当前资源保持风格一致（推荐）: Use the current asset for style consistency (recommended)
translations.尚未添加自定义资源，AI 仍会按蓝图生成默认资源。: No custom assets have been added. AI will still generate the blueprint defaults.
translations.先把多个资源加入计划，再统一生成；当前上传的参考图会用于计划中的每个资源。单个候: Add multiple assets to the plan, then generate them together. Uploaded references apply to every planned asset. Each candidate must still be applied to the draft or saved and enabled.
translations.只保存装饰层，不会应用未确认的配色。: Saves decorations only without applying unconfirmed colors.
translations.在预览中点击装饰，或从下方列表选择。: Click a decoration in the preview or select one from the list below.
translations.先生成或添加装饰层。: Generate or add a decoration first.
translations.开始生成后逐项显示状态。: Asset status appears here after generation starts.
translations.开始生成后，这里会实时显示图片请求、绿幕抠图和资源保存进度。: Image requests, background removal, and asset-save progress appear here in real time.
translations.工作台仍可继续使用，稍后可点击“刷新 DOM 副本”重试: The workspace remains available. Retry later with Refresh DOM Snapshot.
translations.预览 DOM 可能仍是生成前的副本，请刷新后查看最新主题。: The preview DOM may still show the pre-generation snapshot. Refresh it to view the latest theme.
translations.生成结果会复制到主题库并立即启用；保存成功后才会清理恢复检查点。: The result is copied to the theme library and enabled immediately. The recovery checkpoint is cleared only after a successful save.
translations.修改主题库中显示的名称和介绍。: Change the name and description shown in the theme library.
translations.点击背景或关闭按钮返回: Click the backdrop or Close to return
translations.原图加载失败，当前显示缩略图: The original image failed to load; showing the thumbnail
translations.导入 Codex 或社区宠物 ZIP 后，可以预览动作并安装到 Codex。: Import a Codex or community pet ZIP to preview its animations and install it in Codex.
translations.修改宠物库中显示的名称和介绍，不会改变宠物动作。: Change the name and description shown in the pet library without changing its animations.
translations.宠物信息已保存；重新安装后同步到 Codex: Pet details saved. Reinstall to sync them to Codex.
translations.宠物安装后，请在 Codex 的“设置 → 宠物”中选择。重新安装同名宠物时会先: After installation, select the pet in Codex under Settings > Pets. Reinstalling a pet first backs up the current version.
translations.宠物已安装，请在 Codex 的宠物设置中选择: Pet installed. Select it in Codex pet settings.
translations.同时生成与主题配套的 V2 宠物: Also generate a matching V2 pet
translations.当前主题还没有绑定宠物。: The current theme does not have a matching pet yet.
translations.可选：最多 6 张宠物造型参考图。留空时自动复用主题参考图，再留空则只用文字描述: Optionally add up to six pet appearance references. When empty, theme references are reused; without either, generation uses text only.
